correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed all 48 tetrahedra from the frozen 48-facet list, obtaining f=(12,60,96,48), missing graph-edge pairs {(1,7),...,(6,12)}, 160 three-cliques and exactly 64 nonfacial triangular loops. Exact mod-two boundary rank 48 inside 49-dimensional graph cycle space gives H1(F2) dimension 1; direct reduction finds each of 64 nonfacial boundaries nonzero. Published topology RP3 implies integral H1=Z2, and H0 torsion-free means mod-two reduction of its unique torsion generator is nonzero, so these are exactly the simple integral 3-edge systoles. Exhausted all 6!·2^6=46080 permutations of six opposite pairs, precisely 24 facet-preserving automorphisms, and computed orbit sizes 4/12/24/24, representatives (1,5,9),(1,2,12),(1,2,4),(1,2,6); four smallest orbit triangles cover all 12 vertices disjointly. No geometric/Riemannian-length conclusion.
